sanskrit: brahmāsya śiro bṛhad asya pṛṣṭhaṃ vāmadevyam udaram odanasya | chandāṃsi pakṣau mukham asya satyaṃ viṣṭārī yajñas tapaso 'dhi jātaḥ ||
english: Brahman is its head, the Bṛhat-sāman its back, Vāmadevya is the belly of the odana-rice; the metres are its wings, truth is its face — the viṣṭārin oblation is born from austerity, a far-spreading sacrifice.

sanskrit: anasthāḥ śuddhāḥ pavanena pūtāḥ śucayaḥ śucīn api yanti lokān | viṣṭāriṇam odanaṃ ye pacanti naiṣāṃ śiśnaṃ pra dahati jātavedāḥ ||
english: Boneless, pure, cleansed by the wind, radiant — they pass on to radiant worlds. Those who cook the viṣṭārin odana: Jātavedas shall not scorch their organ of generation.

sanskrit: naiṣāṃ śiśnaṃ pra dahati jātavedāḥ svarge loke bahu straiṇam eṣām | nainān yamaḥ pari muṣṇāti retaḥ ||
english: Jātavedas shall not scorch their organ of generation; in the heavenly world abundant womanly pleasures shall be theirs. Yama shall not rob them of their seed.

sanskrit: āste yama upa yāti devān saṃ gandharvair madati somyaiḥ | viṣṭāriṇam odanaṃ ye pacanti nainān avartiḥ sacate kutaś cana ||
english: He sits with Yama, he approaches the gods, he rejoices together with the Soma-intoxicated Gandharvas. Those who cook the viṣṭārin odana — adversity shall not cling to them from any quarter.

sanskrit: rathī ha bhūtvā rathayāna īyate pakṣī ha bhūtvāpi divaṃ sam eti | eṣa yajño vitato vahiṣṭho viṣṭārī pakvo divam ā sasāda ||
english: Becoming a charioteer, he travels onward in a chariot; becoming a bird, he ascends even to the sky. This sacrifice, spread wide, the most carrying of all — the viṣṭārin, once cooked, has reached heaven.

sanskrit: caturaḥ kumbhāṃś caturdhā dadāti kṣīreṇa pūrṇān udakena dadhnā | etās tvā kulyā upa yantu viśvataḥ svarge loke svadhayā pinvamānāḥ ||
english: He gives four jars fourfold, filled with milk, with water, with curds. May these channels flow toward you from every side, swelling with libation in the heavenly world.

sanskrit: ghṛtahradā madhukūlāḥ surodakāḥ kṣīreṇa pūrṇā udakena dadhnā | etās tvā kulyā upa yantu viśvahā svarge loke svadhayā mādayantīḥ ||
english: Lakes of ghee, banks of honey, of good water, filled with milk, with water, with curds — may these channels flow to you forever, gladdening you with libation in the heavenly world.

sanskrit: puṇḍarīkaṃ kumudaṃ saṃ tanoti bisaṃ śālūkaṃ śaphako mulālī | svarge loke svadhayā pinvamānā upa mā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samaktāḥ ||
english: The white lotus, the kumuda water-lily, the lotus-fibre, the śālūka water-root, the śaphaka and the mulālī — may the brimming lotus-pools, swelling with libation in the heavenly world, stand ready about me.

sanskrit: yam odanaṃ pacāmi śraddadhāno viṣṭāriṇaṃ lokajitaṃ svargam | sa me mā kṣeṣṭa sadam aśyamāno viśvarūpā kāmadughā dhenur astu me ||
english: The odana I cook with faith — the viṣṭārin, the heaven-winning, the world-conquering — let it not be exhausted for me as it is ever being eaten; may it be for me an all-form wish-milking cow.

sanskrit: vṛṣabhaṃ santaṃ saha sūnṛtayā svarge loke amṛtaṃ duhānam | ye me putrāḥ pitaraś ca santi te tvā viṣṭārinn upa sarve sadeyuḥ ||
english: Being a bull, together with the sweet truth, milking immortality in the heavenly world — may those who are my sons and my fathers, all of them, sit near you, O viṣṭārin.

sanskrit: ya imān yajñān abhi vitaṣṭāra yasyeme lokāḥ svadhayā samaktāḥ | ye me pautrā uta ye pitāmahās tebhyo viṣṭārinn amṛtāni dhukṣva ||
english: He who has spread out these sacrifices, for whose sake these worlds are anointed with libation — milk out immortalities for them, O viṣṭārin: my grandsons and my grandfathers.

sanskrit: yadi pṛthivīṃ yady antarikṣaṃ yadi divaṃ devatā vā jagantha | ye me prapautrāḥ prapitāmahāś ca te tvā viṣṭārinn anu pra jñeṣur atra ||
english: Whether you have spread over the earth, or over the atmosphere, or over the sky, or over the divine realm — may my great-grandsons and my great-great-grandfathers recognize you here, O viṣṭārin.

sanskrit: svarge loke apsarasa enāñ jāyā bhūtvopa śerate | viṣṭāriṇam odanaṃ ye pacanty asmiṃl loke dakṣiṇayā pariṣkṛtam ||
english: In the heavenly world the Apsarases lie beside them, having become their wives — those who cook the viṣṭārin odana in this world, adorned with the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit: nir ṇudaināṃ pra ṇudaināṃ svān nipadanād adhi | vibhraṃśam asyai kṛṇmo vi gṛhair bhraṃśatām asau ||
english: Drive her out, thrust her forth, beyond falling among her own kinsfolk. We make a falling-away for her — let that woman be sundered from her home.

sanskrit: apāñcaṃ patim ā kurv adharācīṃ striyaṃ naya | atīmān daśa parvatān atīmā nāvyā daśa ||
english: Turn the husband away westward; lead the woman downward and away. Let her pass beyond ten mountains, let her pass beyond ten navigable rivers.

sanskrit: adharācīm avācīm atho akuśalāṃ diśam | vibhraṃśam asyai kṛṇmas tenaināṃ pra dahāmasi ||
english: Toward the downward, the southward, toward the inauspicious direction — we make a falling-away for her; with that we burn her away.

sanskrit: āja nir aja bilaṃ bilād araṇyam ā kurv araṇyād araṇaṃ janam | mṛgām̐ anu pra pātaya vātasyaināṃ śikhāṃ kuru ||
english: Drive her out, drive her from the hole; from the hole make her enter the forest; from the forest make her a stranger among strangers. Set her chasing after wild beasts; make the wind the forelock of her hair.

sanskrit: vātāgre asyā hṛdayaṃ mano reṣmaṇi dadhmasi | vibhraṃśam asyai kṛṇmo vidhvaṃśam āsaktaṃ dame ||
english: Her heart and mind we blow into the fore-rush of the wind, into the snot. We make a falling-away for her — a scattering from her clinging to the household.

sanskrit: sarvam anu pari plavatām antarā dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe | yathānavadhṛtā carād vṛṣatūlam ivopari ||
english: Let her float about following everything between both heaven and earth, as one unrestrained might wander, like a lock of rain-cloud cotton drifting overhead.

sanskrit: aśam asyai vāto vātv aśaṃ tapatu sūryaḥ | atho yad annam aśnāti tad asyai viṣavattaram ||
english: Let the wind blow ill upon her, let the sun scorch her with ill. And whatever food she eats, let that be more poisonous than poison to her.

sanskrit: siṃhas te astu cakṣuṣa ity ekā ||
english: "Let a lion be before your eyes" — thus the single verse.

sanskrit: eṣa vām agnir antarā sa viṣvañcau vy asyatu | yathā vāṃ na sahāsaty uttarasmiṃś canāyuṣi ||
english: This fire between you two — let it throw you both asunder, so that you shall not dwell together even in the furthest span of life.

sanskrit: ut pātaya śimidāvati pra pātaya śimidāvati | imau vy asya dampatī pakvaṃ māṃsam ivāsinā ||
english: Make them fly up asunder, O śimidā-plant; make them fly apart asunder, O śimidā — cleave these two householders apart as with a knife through cooked flesh.

sanskrit: meyam asmin patau raṃsta mo asmiñ chayane sve | jahātu vasanaṃ svam ahir jīrṇām iva tvacam ||
english: Let her not delight in this husband of hers, nor in this her own marriage-bed. Let her abandon her own dwelling as a serpent abandons its worn-out skin.

sanskrit: yathā mṛtāś ca jīvāś ca- -asmiṃl loke vyokasaḥ | evemau dampatī stām asmiṃl loke vyokasau ||
english: As the dead and the living are without a common dwelling in this world, so let these two — husband and wife — be without a common dwelling in this world.
